title: Positioning on the pitch
heatmapSub: Where the referee spent the match, attacking left to right
decisionPointsSub: How far the referee was when each call was made
diagonalSub: Time spent inside the recommended diagonal channel
sightLineNote: The dashed line runs from the referee's position to the decision — its length is the measured distance. {n} calls were made from beyond 20 m.
diagonalNote: The diagonal is the channel the referee is meant to hold. Every call made outside it costs viewing angle — that is the direct link between positioning and accuracy.
amberNote: Amber bars are the calls overturned on review.

form.title: Record positioning
form.heatHint: One per line: x, y, intensity (0-105, 0-68, 0-1).
form.noneYet: No positioning data recorded for this match yet.

errors.number: A valid number, in the expected range.
errors.partial: Fill in all five physical values, or none.
errors.lines: One line per point, with the right values.
errors.duplicateMinute: Each minute may appear only once.
errors.condition: Letters, numbers and common punctuation, 40 characters at most.
errors.conditionRequired: Give the weather condition to record a temperature or humidity.
